summary:
AstroMed AI is a mobile-first medical assistant for astronauts on long space missions, where help from Earth can be delayed by about 20 minutes or lost completely.

The problem: Long missions bring health risks like space motion sickness, bone loss, vision changes (SANS), fluid shifts, weaker immunity, sleep and mental health problems, blood clots, and kidney stones. Kidney stones are one of the most likely reasons for an emergency evacuation from the ISS, and painkillers on board may not be enough.
details: It helps astronauts to keep record on their health status and and track their health condition frequently and gives alert and med info when its an emergency situation the app was deployed on netlify its creative beacause of easy access at emergency situation and live alert signals etc
